title: Earliest track: complete Staging, expand Production to the second cluster
notes: Staging reaches both clusters, so it now serves true to all Staging traffic. Production adds prod-sa-east-02 at ten per cent, taking the Production share from five to fifteen per cent.

Cluster rules rather than a fallthrough change: the terminal fully-rolled-out state is deliberately saved for the final step, so the crossover stays legible as an accelerating curve of 5, 15, 30, 60 and 100 per cent.
Verified before this step: the canary was serving true to exactly 5 of 100 Production contexts and 12 of 30 Staging contexts, matching prod-eu-west-02 at five per cent and stg-eu-central-02 at forty.
The three open-track flags are deliberately untouched. They advance one cluster every day or two so they remain visibly mid-rollout on 5 October.
